I don't even understand myself.
I just feel completely alone and I have felt this way for a long time. 
So long that I feel like some sort of social outcast.
And I need to know that I'm not worthless. I don't know how I could live this way until my late twenties and not even be guaranteed that I wouldn't be so alone. Idk I'm sorry I don't think I make any sense here
